No task-owned build, E2E or cleanup overlap. No Release, cloud, empty-cache or archive-scale qualification.

No Release, cloud, empty-cache or archive-scale qualification.

qualification: Warm local Debug on a shared macOS ARM64 host. No task-owned build, E2E or cleanup overlapped these 24 runs. Separate-worktree build activity was observed on the shared host before the comparison. Seven samples per source-refinement, typed-result and rare-term point; three per other point/order. Every sample and slower control is retained. Publication admission/readiness polling is a single observation per run, not isolated indexing CPU. No Release, cloud-latency, empty-cache, archive-scale or exact full-query-memory qualification. A corrected typed-fixture smoke run overlapped native testing; all of its timings were discarded and are excluded here.

validation_before_final_main.native_command: ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR=.zig-cache/global ~/bin/zig build lake-text-frontier-test lake-integration-test antfly -j2 --cache-dir .zig-cache -Dtest-filter="external lake" -Dtest-filter=highlight -Dtest-filter="serverless graph compact"
development_checks: An initial compile rejected a nested row parameter shadowing Page.row; it was renamed cell_index and all affected checks passed.

The initial heterogeneous-vector allocation-fault sweep reported nondeterministic remap allocation counts; disabling remaps in its failure allocator stabilized the exhaustive sweep. No leaks were reported, and the rerun passed.
The first wide-delivery smoke fixture omitted the ordered ID sortable annotation. The fixture was corrected and all value oracles passed. Overlapping smoke timings are discarded.
